hero.heading: Windshield Chip Repair in Boulder City, NV
hero.intro: A rock kicks up from the shoulder on the way through the valley and taps your windshield, and a chip smaller than a coin is suddenly staring back at you every time you drive. Left alone, desert heat is not gentle on that damage, and a small chip can spread into a crack across your sightline before you get around to it. BC Glass and Tint checks the damage first, then fills and seals chips and, when the damage allows it, small cracks before that happens. Insurance sometimes covers the cost, and we are open Tuesday to Saturday for drivers across Boulder City, Henderson and Las Vegas.
